title: THOS cluster-randomized site-participant estimand and informative-cluster-size protocol
hypothesis: A proxy protocol can distinguish site-level from participant-level estimands and reject analyses whose cluster-size mechanism or post-allocation recruitment changes the target effect.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate randomization unit, estimand population, cluster-size mechanism, recruitment timing, contamination, correlation, weighting, real-arm count, and claim class; ambiguous, biased, or promoted designs must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
